reason: A user-interface theming plugin that provides preset and natural-language color schemes, custom background images, coordinated control styling, and cross-device theme setting synchronization.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供预设和自然语言换肤、自定义背景图片、控件配色联动及跨设备主题设置同步。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with preset and natural-language themes, custom background images, coordinated control styling, and cross-device theme setting synchronization.

capabilities: Applies preset and generated color themes
Sets a custom page background image from an upload or URL
Synchronizes theme settings across devices through the host settings and RPC mechanisms
Updates interface control styling through theme tokens and inline overrides
